mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS declines (t-test p-value > 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows) or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.2% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger a flight to quality in equities, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.2% (over 3-year rolling window) or Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a weakening housing market that reduces consumer confidence and aggregate demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both RSAFS and HOUST decline (over 3-year rolling window) or Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of manufacturing supply chain disruption (INDPRO below 100), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the next 20 trading days as firms face higher input costs and reduced output.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100 (over 3-year rolling window) or Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% (over 3-year rolling window) or Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) above its 12-month moving average indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS increases (t-test p-value > 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows) or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong consumer demand (GDPC1 growth above 2.0% annually), the S&P 500 experiences positive returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate profits rise.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 annual growth > 2.0% (over 3-year rolling window) or Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When manufacturing production (INDPRO) falls below 95 for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in industrial output that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 95 for 2 consecutive months (over 3-year rolling window) or Rank IC < 0.02.
